things_the_build_should_know: scvi-tools: passing logger=False to train() leaves model.history empty, so convergence cannot be audited. Agent3 did this. Keep the default logger.

The 802-patient task cohort spans 19 collection sites, not 39 (39 is the count for all 1,061 patients). The five largest sites hold 426 patients; 3 sites have fewer than 10; 14 sites contain all four classes.
HER2 status is not definite for 255 of 802 patients (123 missing, 125 equivocal, 7 indeterminate).
First import of scanpy/torch/scvi on a compute node takes 20-50 s; reading the PBMC HDF5 and slicing by feature type took about 100 s with the Agent3-style loader.
Peak annotation has one row per peak with ';'-separated genes and peak types.
All 16 H100 GPUs were busy at 03:00 with forecast waits of 6-7 hours; CPU jobs started within seconds.
